title: Configure repository and schema resolution for external work-item validation
objective: Separate the target repository root from the installed SDLC schema registry so sdlc work-item/task validation works for external repositories such as BTCUSD-0000, add a nodejs-common-backed ~/.sdlc/config.json repositoryRoot default with documented precedence, and add ./scripts/install.mjs with an idempotent --hooks option that installs all supported Git hooks.

branch.name: WI-0027-configured-schema-resolution-and-hooks
branch.rationale: WI-0027 planning is prepared on main; implementation and validation will use the declared context branch after start.

request.text:
Determine the root cause of this:

> sdlc work-item validate --work-item BTCUSD-0000
Work item validation for BTCUSD-0000: failed
  Objects: 0/1 valid
  FAIL work-item .docs/work-items/BTCUSD-0000/work-item.json
Finding: FAIL /tmp/sdlc-work-item-validation-Z9wfS3/work-item.json
  $ [schema] Cannot read schema: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/home/michael/src/algorithms/coinbase-btcusd/schemas/work-item/v2/work-item.schema.json'
Remediation: Fix the object at .docs/work-items/BTCUSD-0000/work-item.json so it conforms to schemas/work-item/v2/work-item.schema.json, then rerun validation.

It looks like the root directory for schema resolution is based on the executing directory. Perhaps we should be using schema-validate and its registry feature to resolve schemas. We could also be using a ~/.sdlc/config.json that specifies a repository directory and then we use that. ~/src/github/nodejs-common/ package provides a configuration provider that can check home, local and envvar in a pre-defined order.

Prepare a ./scripts/install.mjs that installs a default ~/.sdlc/config.json and configures the repositoryRoot default. include a --hooks switch that installs all git hooks.

Write the .docs/work-items/* to accomplish the above and commit the work item.

scope.name: schema-registry-root-separation
scope.description: Resolve SDLC schemas from the installed package registry or an explicitly configured registry rather than assuming the target repository contains schemas/.
scope.reason: External repositories can contain valid work items without vendoring the sdlc schema tree.

scope.name: repository-root-configuration
scope.description: Define a versioned ~/.sdlc/config.json contract with repositoryRoot and use nodejs-common application, home, and SDLC_CONFIG environment precedence with provenance and safe path handling.
scope.reason: Validation launched outside the target repository needs a deterministic configured repository default.

scope.name: operative-root-selection
scope.description: Make repository-dependent commands select an explicit or configured repository root when the current working directory is not the target repository, while preserving current Git-root behavior when no override is configured.
scope.reason: The BTCUSD-0000 failure occurs because the executing repository is incorrectly treated as the target and schema repository simultaneously.

scope.name: installer-and-hooks
scope.description: Add ./scripts/install.mjs to install the default user configuration and, with --hooks, install every supported managed Git hook idempotently without destroying unmanaged hook content.
scope.reason: Users need one repeatable setup command for configuration and repository hook protection.

scope.name: external-repository-validation
scope.description: Exercise BTCUSD-0000-style external repositories without schema trees, nested CWD invocation, schema-registry resolution, work-item/task validation, and hook subprocess behavior in isolated fixtures.
scope.reason: The reported failure must be reproduced and prevented at the exact command boundary.

nonGoals.name: remote-schema-download
nonGoals.description: Do not download schemas or contact remote registries during validation.
nonGoals.reason: The installed package registry and explicit local configuration are sufficient and keep validation offline.

nonGoals.name: global-git-config-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not change global Git configuration or install hooks outside the selected repository.
nonGoals.reason: The --hooks option is repository-scoped and must remain safe for users with multiple repositories.

nonGoals.name: automatic-repository-discovery-overrides
nonGoals.description: Do not silently replace an explicit command repository selection with the current working directory or an unrelated configured path.
nonGoals.reason: Repository selection must be deterministic, diagnosable, and preserve source provenance.

nonGoals.name: historical-work-item-repair
nonGoals.description: Do not automatically rewrite invalid external work items; validation and migration remain separate operations.
nonGoals.reason: Configuration should correct schema lookup, not mutate target repository records.

items.name: schema-root-separation
items.description: sdlc work-item validate and sdlc task validate must resolve work-item, task-envelope, and selected task schemas from the installed sdlc schema registry or an explicitly configured registry, never by assuming the target repository contains schemas/.
items.reason: The reported ENOENT comes from using /home/michael/src/algorithms/coinbase-btcusd/schemas as both target repository and schema registry.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid BTCUSD-0000 fixture in a repository without a schemas directory validates its work-item and task records successfully using the installed sdlc schema registry.
Schema-read failures identify the selected schema registry root and target repository separately, with no path based on an unrelated executing repository.

items.name: sdlc-config-contract
items.description: The repository must define a versioned sdlc/config/v1 schema for ~/.sdlc/config.json with repositoryRoot as an absolute existing-directory path and optional schemaRegistryRoot, plus source provenance and safe invalid-path behavior.
items.reason: A persisted configuration contract is required for reproducible external repository commands.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The default installed ~/.sdlc/config.json contains repositoryRoot for the selected repository, validates against sdlc/config/v1, and is not overwritten when the user already has a valid configuration.
Configuration resolution follows nodejs-common application .config, ~/.sdlc, and SDLC_CONFIG environment precedence, rejects relative/missing roots and traversal, and reports the selected source.

items.name: repository-root-selection
items.description: Repository-dependent commands must use an explicit repository-root option when supplied, otherwise a configured repositoryRoot default when the current working directory is not a repository, and otherwise the nearest Git repository as today.
items.reason: The reported command needs a stable target repository without breaking existing nested-CWD behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running sdlc work-item validate --work-item BTCUSD-0000 from outside or beside the target Git repository validates the configured target repository and reports its repository root and paths.

An explicit repository selection takes precedence over configuration, configuration takes precedence over fallback discovery only when no current target repository is available, and invalid selection fails with actionable remediation.

items.name: installer-default-and-hooks
items.description: ./scripts/install.mjs must safely install the default user configuration and support --hooks to install every supported managed Git hook in the selected repository, idempotently preserving unmanaged content.
items.reason: The requested setup must be one command and must cover both configuration and Git hook installation without an external manager.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Running ./scripts/install.mjs creates ~/.sdlc/config.json only when absent or explicitly requested, writes the selected repositoryRoot, validates the result, and is idempotent.

Running ./scripts/install.mjs --hooks installs every supported managed hook, makes hooks executable, preserves unmanaged hook content, replaces only managed blocks, and is byte-for-byte idempotent on repetition.

items.name: external-validation-and-hook-fixtures
items.description: The implementation must include isolated fixtures and tests for external repositories without schema trees, nested CWD invocation, configuration precedence, schema registry selection, work-item/task validation, installer behavior, all-hook installation, failure output, and read-only boundaries.
items.reason: The reported failure and setup workflow cross configuration, CLI, schema resolution, and Git hook execution.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tests cover the default configuration path, application/home/environment precedence, explicit override, external BTCUSD-0000 validation, schema-root diagnostics, and config provenance.
Tests cover every supported hook installation path, idempotence, existing-hook preservation, invalid configuration blocking, complete validation output, and unchanged target files.

items.name: complete-gates-and-self-validation
items.description: Implementation and validation must pass typecheck, build, complete tests, schema audit, external-repository validation, config/install tests, hook tests, and sdlc work-item validate before their commits and before the work-item commit.
items.reason: The change affects command root selection, schema lookup, configuration, installer writes, and Git hook execution.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The committed work item passes sdlc work-item validate with zero invalid objects and zero unresolved references, and every task records the required gate evidence.
